tweets.text:
Politicians will always be politicians. Instead of realizing that the Strait of Hormuz issue + incoming global oil shortage won’t be resolved even after the SPR release, they are opting to buy time. Time the world doesn’t have, no matter how sizable the SPR is.
It’s like throwing bottles of water at a burning house. It’s not really going to do anything unless you solve the underlying issue.

The dilemma the world faces today is that the hefty inventory surplus has now turned into a deficit. China, which held a large crude oil surplus, is now buying crude. The world no longer benefits from the 4 to 5 million b/d reduction in Chinese crude imports. What was once seen as a headwind for the crude oil market is now turning into a tailwind. And despite many analysts pointing to higher Strait of Hormuz oil flows, the return of Chinese crude buying is the same black-box fundamental variable as the lack of buying.

If China buys the crude, which caused the Strait of Hormuz flow to increase, it has no relevance to the rest of the world. China is its own variable, black-box-in, black-box-out.

There’s been a ton of blood in the trenches the last few weeks.

As boring as my “Stack HMM and chill” plan might feel some days, it’s saved my port during this broader market drawdown.

A lot of the names that appeared out of nowhere after it and hit similar mcaps have already practically bled to zero.

One of the the reasons I’m so bullish on HMM moving forward is that it’s given so much time for people to organically enter while it’s accumulated in this range.

E.g. if a coin runs up to $100M overnight, likely only a few people really make life changing money on that first move, and they didn’t invest nearly as much time to get those returns. When HMM makes the next leg up to $100M+, there’s a huge base of holders (not just the typical big names) that win, and it’ll have taken time and belief to get there.

I believe that’s what it takes to hit billions.

So I’ll continue to stack and chill, and trust that the proliferation of the chain + crypto will take care of the rest naturally.

I’ve continued to stack more HMM with my fomo fees every day and will continue to do so as long as we’re in this range ➡️ https://t.co/xuYbTqyGvJ

Learn to bullieve in something again. 🤔🐈
